title: Yummy Vietnamese Rice Noodle Pho
description: A smoky, fiery bowl of rice noodle pho packed with chili flakes and post-workout protein.
instructions: Heat the kadhai over medium-high heat and add sesame oil, then swirl to coat the bottom.
Add minced garlic and ginger, sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Pour in smoked beef broth and bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in fish sauce, lime juice, and chili flakes, allowing the flavors to meld for 2 minutes.
Add the thinly sliced beef, letting it cook until just browned, about 2-3 minutes.
While the beef cooks, steam the rice noodles until just soft, then drain.
Toss the cooked noodles into the broth, ensuring they are evenly coated.
Stir in chopped bok choy and simmer until wilted, about 1 minute.
Serve hot, garnishing with fresh cilantro, mint, and scallions if desired.
